cap: Prostate cancer cells depend on androgen receptor signaling. Leuprolide and goserelin are GnRH agonists: continuous stimulation desensitizes the pituitary, so testosterone flares and then falls, and an antiandrogen covers the flare. Degarelix, a GnRH antagonist, causes no flare. Bicalutamide, flutamide and enzalutamide block the receptor, and abiraterone inhibits CYP17 and is given with prednisone to prevent mineralocorticoid excess.
